title_sq: Tek Kompleksi E88, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1 Me Hapsira Te Bollshme !!

title_en: In Complex E88, Super Apartment 2+1 With Ample Spaces For Sale!!
description_en: In the E88 Complex, in the Laprak area near the Dome, 2+1 Apartment for Sale with Perfect Orientation! The apartment is located on the 6th floor of an 8-story building, with an elevator and construction of 2024, which is nearing the handover stage. The property has a gross area of ​​127.51 m2 and a net area of ​​109.80 m2. It is organized by: living room with kitchenette and exit to the balcony, matrimonial room, children's room, two toilets and balcony. The north-west orientation of the apartment enables natural lighting. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life and access to the center of the capital. Currently, the complex is in the delivery phase.
